newsitem.title: UK: Beta unit invests in Cuba financial services.
newsitem.headline: Beta unit invests in Cuba financial services.

text.p: Beta Gran Caribe Limited has completed a SFR 6.0 million investment in Antilles Finance Limited, which has an effective 70 percent equity interest in Caribbean Finance Corporation Limited (CFC).
A statement said CFC is incorporated in Guernsey and aims to develop financial services in Cuba, including the provision of trade finance, and later on of leasing facilities.

International Financial and Investment Holdings Co Ltd, which is domiciled in the Cayman Islands, has substantial experience in the financial services sector in Cuba and has also agreed to invest in CFC, the statement said.
